Shared-memory clock synchronization APIs, epochs, and default init/recalibration helpers.

# Purpose
`fd_clock.h` defines the public interface for a shared-memory clock synchronization object that maps a fast local clock to a slower reference clock. It provides constructors, join and leave functions, recalibration and step functions, and observer APIs that let threads convert local tick counts into wall-clock time with low overhead. The file also defines the internal shared-memory layout, epoch cache data, error codes, alignment and footprint values, and inline helpers for reading the current epoch and estimating time. Default helper functions are included for the common case of synchronizing the CPU tick counter with the host wall clock in a single-threaded setup.
